# FDGA026

> DO add a blank line after “paragraphs” of code where it enhances readability.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.4 Vertical Whitespace.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

## From the book

```csharp
switch (someExpression)
{
    case 0xs:
        DoSomething();
        break;
    ...
}
```

> **Jeremy Barton:** I add a blank line when the next statement is subjectively “less” related to the previous one than the one before.
>
> ```
> int size = value.BitCount;
> size = (size + 7) / 8;
>
> byte[] tmp = new byte[size];
>
> ...
> ```
